reference.Aref_note: PINNED 2026-09-10 by the cfd-supervisor (check-4 freeze act). This is the 5-degree WEDGE SECTOR area in m^2, NOT the full revolution: grade_suboff.py reads forceCoeffs Aref out of system/controlDict, which carries the sector, so a full-revolution value here would refuse every level. Full revolution = 5.988264212260189 m^2 = 72 x this. RULING: ONE pinned Aref is used at every level, replacing the previous per-level built-area normalisation. Reasons: (1) A_ref is a DEFINITIONAL reference area in Cd = F/(0.5 rho U^2 A_ref), not a mesh property; (2) per-level Aref would ARTIFICIALLY REMOVE A REAL DISCRETISATION ERROR -- how well the mesh represents the wetted area is part of the discretisation error, and dividing it out level-by-level hides it while injecting a monotone ~0.171% normalisation drift into the Roache triple; (3) the built sector area is not even an unbiased estimator of the wetted area -- the OpenFOAM wedge convention places points at z = +/-R*tan(2.5deg), giving face width 2R*tan(2.5deg) against a true arc of R*(5deg in rad), a systematic +0.092% bias (INFERRED arithmetic, not measured), so per-level normalisation would divide by a biased, level-dependent number. The builder still MEASURES and RECORDS each level's built sector area in its birth certificate; only the normalisation is pinned.
reference.S_wetted_provenance: RE-DERIVED 2026-09-10 by independent numerical quadrature of the surface of revolution, S = int 2*pi*R(x)*sqrt(1+(dR/dx)^2) dx, over the four TABLE 1 hull segments of Groves/Huang/Chang 1989 (DTRC/SHD-1298-01, 'Geometric Characteristics of DARPA SUBOFF Models', report p.4 = PDF p.11), title-page verified per rule 15 from PAGE IMAGES. Instrument: cases/navier_class/SUBOFF/derive_wetted_area.py. The nose carries an integrable singularity (R ~ x^(1/2.1)) removed exactly by x = u^21 and cross-checked by tanh-sinh at 40 dps; Gauss-Legendre over m in {11,21,31} at n = 80..320 agrees to ~1e-12 relative. Limiting error is TABLE 1's own printed rounding (2.0e-7 m^2 = 3.4e-6%), so ~7 significant figures are supported. The inherited 4-s.f. value 5.988 is CONFIRMED, not corrected: the derived value sits +0.0044% above it, inside the +/-0.008% implied by four figures. WARNING, a clean negative worth carrying: the Groves 1989 report does NOT state a wetted area anywhere -- it gives defining equations, code listings and tap locations. Anyone citing Groves 1989 FOR THE AREA is citing it for something it does not say; the area is DERIVED from its equations. SECOND WARNING: the .txt sidecar beside that PDF is OCR-DEGRADED and would poison this derivation -- it renders R_MAX = 5/6 ft as 0.0333333 and the afterbody xi denominator origin 13.979167 as 12.979167. TABLE 1 was transcribed from the page image, never from the sidecar.
